verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a first-party Crawl endpoint, a graph-based traversal that explores hundreds of paths in parallel from a base URL, with built-in extraction, natural-language instructions, and depth control via `tvly crawl --depth`. It also has a companion Map endpoint for discovering site structure, and both are exposed through the Python SDK, JS SDK, CLI and MCP. Any search-result URL can be passed as the crawl's starting point. missing for 10: documented search-to-crawl chaining (seeding a crawl directly from search results), detailed docs on crawl scope limits (max pages, path filters), independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl quality.
